landing_sub: Create your server, invite your friends: catches, tech and effigies sync from your server's save, every 6 hours.
landing_private: Free and open source. Discord sign-in, up to 3 servers per account.
landing_meta_description: Shared Paldex, interactive map, tech and crafting for your Palworld tribe: multi-server, automatic save import, free and open source.
landing_feat_paldex_body: Who caught what, at a glance: stats, passive skills and breeding.
landing_feat_map_body: Effigies, alpha bosses and fast travel points, checked off together.
landing_feat_tech_body: The full in-game tree, with everyone's real progression.
landing_feat_craft_body: Recipes, materials and crafting chains, all linked together.
landing_feat_import_body: Connect your server's SFTP in the settings: the save is imported every 6 hours, everything ticks itself off.
landing_feat_servers_body: Create up to 3 servers, invite with revocable links. Each server has its own shared progression.
landing_how_step1_body: Sign in with Discord, nothing else to create. Create your server or join a friend's through their invite link.
landing_how_step2_body: Generate an invite link (optional expiry and max uses, revocable at any time). Everyone then claims their in-game character in one click.
landing_how_step3_body: Optional: add your dedicated server's SFTP in the settings. Encrypted credentials, auto-detected world folder, import every 6 hours.
landing_faq_a1: Yes. No subscription, no ads. The project is open source under the GPL-3.0 license.
landing_faq_q2: What do I need to get started?
landing_faq_a2: A Discord account, that's it. Create your server, invite your friends and track progress together. Automatic import is optional.
landing_faq_q3: Which Palworld servers work with automatic import?
landing_faq_a3: Any dedicated server reachable over SFTP. The world folder is detected automatically; you can also set it manually.
landing_faq_a4: Only the members of your server. Each server is isolated: nothing is shared across servers, nor with third parties.
landing_faq_a5: They are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before being stored, never displayed back, visible to no member, and you can delete them at any time.
landing_faq_q6: How many servers can I create?
landing_faq_a6: Up to 3 per account. You can however join as many servers as you like through invites.
landing_faq_q7: Can I host my own instance?
landing_faq_a7: Yes: the code is GPL-3.0. Clone the GitHub repo and follow the README's self-hosting guide.
landing_selfhost_body: Palworld Companion is free and open source. Prefer full control? Clone the repo, plug in your Postgres database and Discord app, and run your own instance. The full guide is in the README.
landing_final_title: Ready to tick off your world together?
landing_footer_license: Free software under the GPL-3.0 license.
landing_footer_disclaimer: Not affiliated with Pocketpair, Inc. Palworld assets belong to their rightful owners.
docs_intro: Everything you need to know to use Palworld Companion with your tribe: getting started, invites, automatic import and self-hosting.
docs_start_signin_body: No account to create: authentication goes through Discord (identity only, no access to your Discord servers).
docs_start_create_body: A server = a Palworld world shared with your tribe. Each account can create up to 3; each server has its own private URL.
docs_start_invite_body: From the server settings, generate an invite link: optional expiry and max uses, revocable at any time. Anyone with the link joins the server after signing in.
docs_start_claim_body: After a first save import, the Import page lists the server's players: click "That's me" to link your character and see your personal progression.
docs_start_sftp_body: (Owner) Add your dedicated server's SFTP access in Settings → SFTP import: test the connection, the world folder is detected automatically, then the save is imported every 6 hours. Manual import remains available.
docs_sharing_body: Your progression is only visible to the members of your server. Each server is fully isolated.
docs_sharing_list_1: The import reads the server save: players, catches, unlocked technologies and effigies.
docs_sharing_list_2: The Paldex, map, technology and crafting pages show each member's and the group's progression.
docs_sharing_list_3: SFTP credentials are encrypted (AES-256-GCM), never displayed back, visible to no member, and can be deleted at any time.
docs_sharing_list_4: No data is shared across servers, nor with third parties.
docs_selfhost_body: Palworld Companion is open source (GPL-3.0). You can host your own instance: the full guide (environment variables, Postgres database, Discord OAuth, import cron) lives in the repository README.
